scope: source-based independent multi-item recipe/fuel repair and runtime batch inventory

fixes.behavior: 1/9 U compound -> one alloy nugget in vanilla/GT furnace; explicit material payload and matching crucible viewer row
GT6 grass, crop, resin, remains, apple cores, dry bark and bale values; native Forge/NeoForge fuel hook plus GT solid burning box; Bark forms preserve 100 ticks/U
furnace/smoker -> sticky goo; mortar and shredder -> one bone meal; original family Generifier conversion
RM.biomass(8) with original per-fluid yields and duration; Generifier -> plant remains
2U scrap meat grinding/rotting; explicit raw/cooked meat-bar payload, compression/grinding/rotting; seven raw meat material-form cooking rows
six source ingredients + Purple_Drink and fish/whale oil -> 8 chum + 1000 mB Sludge
empty spray can + 2304 mB matching chemical dye, 256 ticks, 16 EU/t

remaining_limits: Batch machine-map audit is not equivalent to every independent identity having a crafting recipe: loot/harvest acquisition, material aliases, interactions and dynamic recipes are separate.
IC2/HBM plantball compression and external AE/TE/IC2 grinding integrations are not invented when those mod items/APIs are absent.
GT6 potion.idunsapplejuice, potion.goldenapplejuice and goldencarrotjuice biomass variants have no ported fluid and remain outside this source-owned-fluid batch.
Coke oven runtime already binds MachineRecipeMaps.CokeOven; viewer catalyst registration delegated to advanced workbench integration domain.
No client visual test, finished-jar installation, full survival loop or saved-world restart in this agent.
